subject: Redlines for Change Order — Nimble AI capacity + SOW adjustments
messages:
From: Carl Myers <carl.myers@nimbleai.com>

Cc: Alice Nguyen <alice@nimbleai.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Change order (capacity + SOW)

Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran internal capacity planning with product and legal and need to propose a short change order: +20% reserved capacity for Q3 (accelerated ramp) and a small SOW edit to add a new evaluation milestone (security baseline checks and perf validation).

Can you share a draft change order plus tracked redlines to the MSA/order form so we can move quickly? We'd like language for:
- commit for additional reserved GPU hours and an addendum to the fee schedule
- revised acceptance milestone for the new perf run (10 business days after delivery)
- an explicit scope note that evaluation data will remain customer-owned and not used for model training (security ask)

Budget owner is Alice — cc'd. We can accelerate approval if the DocuSign path is ready.

Thanks,
Carl

--
Carl Myers
Head of Platform, Nimble AI
carl.myers@nimbleai.com
+1 415-555-0199

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: legal@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: Change order (capacity + SOW)

LA/Ben — forwarding Carl's request from Nimble. They want a narrow change order (capacity + one SOW milestone) and an explicit non-training data clause. Key asks: fee schedule update, acceptance timeline, and data usage language.

Can you:
- Laura: draft a short change order PDF that references the existing MSA/Order Form and includes a fee-row for +20% reserved capacity and an attached SOW_v2_changes.xlsx with the milestone details.
- Ben: check with finance to confirm the price math and whether we can offer a 30-day signoff credit for accelerated ramp (Nimble asked to accelerate).

Attachments from Nimble: I'll attach their note and we'll produce tracked redlines. Goal: return a clean change order + tracked redlines back to Carl by EOD Friday (5/14) so they can circulate to procurement/legal.

Notes for legal: prefer short, surgical redlines. For the data clause, suggest: "Customer Data, including evaluation data, shall remain Customer Data and shall not be used to train Redwood models without explicit written consent." Please advise if stronger language is required.

Thanks — Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Change order (capacity + SOW)

Karthik / Ben — attaching the first pass.

What I'm sending to Nimble (attachments):
- Nimble_ChangeOrder_051227.pdf (short change order referencing MSA #M-2041 and Order Form #OF-331)
- Nimble_redlines_tracked.docx (tracked redlines on MSA + Order Form highlighting the fee row and the new SOW paragraph)
- SOW_v2_changes.xlsx (spreadsheet with the new milestone, acceptance criteria and dates)

Key legal notes in tracked redlines:
1) Data use: used your proposed sentence but added an exception for aggregated/anonymous telemetry required for platform ops ("Telemetry: Redwood may collect aggregated, de-identified usage metrics for platform debugging and capacity planning; such telemetry shall not include evaluation data tied to Customer PII or prompts.").
2) Acceptance timing: we set perf validation to 10 business days after delivery and included a remediation window of 5 business days for any failed runs.
3) Fee schedule: +20% reserved capacity prorated for remainder of Q3; finance confirmed pro rata and proposed a one-time setup credit of 10% of the incremental monthly fee if signed within 30 days. Ben, please confirm the credit number.

If everyone is aligned I'll send this to Carl with a short note and a DocuSign link for the signature flow. If legal wants a stronger "no training" warranty language, flag it now; we're trying to keep the CO short.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Product Counsel, Redwood Inference

Karthik/Laura — this is great, thanks. The change order PDF and tracked redlines look clean. Two quick items:

1) The Nimble procurement team asked whether the DocuSign can be routed to our procurement mailbox first (procurement@nimbleai.com) before the budget owner signs. Can you add procurement@nimbleai.com to the signature flow?

2) On the telemetry language — we need to ensure it can't be used to reverse engineer evaluation prompts. If you can add an explicit clause that telemetry excludes prompt text and evaluation outputs, that should satisfy our security team.

If you can update the tracked redlines with that tweak and resend, we can get procurement to review by Monday and aim to sign by EOD Tuesday. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Regards,
Carl

Head of Platform, Nimble AI
